rules.condition: first_land_based_receiving and receiving are both supported
rules.rationale: First land-based receiving is a more specific CTE than generic receiving for seafood landing evidence.
Direct-to-consumer movement should not trigger business-to-business shipping CTE classification.

rules.condition: actor role is transporter and no shipper/receiver party is resolved
rules.rationale: Transporter-only records can describe movement without establishing the covered entity CTE role.
rules.reviewer_question: Confirm whether this row represents the covered shipper/receiver or only a transporter/carrier record.

rules.condition: movement appears internal to same actor/location
rules.rationale: Internal movements should not automatically become shipping/receiving CTEs.
rules.reviewer_question: Confirm whether this internal transfer is a reportable shipping/receiving event.

rules.condition: event terms include return, reversal, correction, void, or adjustment
rules.rationale: Return and correction records often refer to prior events rather than new CTEs.
rules.reviewer_question: Review return/correction evidence before classifying the CTE.

rules.rationale: Non-FTL finished form should suppress downstream FTL CTE duties until reviewed.
rules.reviewer_question: Confirm transformed output FTL scope before applying downstream FTL duties.

rules.condition: kill step, exemption, partial exemption, or scope uncertainty is material
rules.rationale: Material uncertainty should create reviewer questions instead of confident findings.
rules.reviewer_question: Resolve exemption, kill-step, or food-scope uncertainty before confident CTE classification.

rules.rationale: Traceability plan evidence is governance evidence, not a movement/transformation CTE.
